sentences.en: The 16-year-old actor admitted he is considering other projects after playing bespectacled Harry for more than five years.

sentences.en: A bespectacled young priest, Yousuf, led us barefoot into the unbearable crush of bodies around the saint's silver casket.

sentences.en: A bespectacled Dan (Jude Law) is walking down a London street when he sees a gorgeous redhead, Alice (Portman ).

sentences.en: They were silent; they were bespectacled; and most of them were reading texts with titles like Operating Systems.

sentences.en: A tall, bespectacled figure, his face half concealed by a luxuriant walrus moustache, Perky had enjoyed an extraordinary career.
